verdicts.reason: A: the headline, three flavour names, body copy, the yellow delivery line and three descriptors are all jammed into one block with no spacing. The flavour names are nearly as large as the headline, and the descriptors no longer sit with their flavours (Honey Rosemary is now paired with 'Bright & zesty'). The SOLSTICE logo is tiny and off-axis, and the two small cans at the bottom are leftover fragments. Still, the full-width CTA is clear and the main can and badge read in sequence. B: the same broken split between flavour names and descriptors, but worse hierarchy, with 'Cucumber Mint' set larger than the headline and the descriptors big enough to compete with it. The CTA is shrunk to a small pill and the ONLY ONLINE badge is wedged against it. The two bottom cans are mismatched in size, and the middle has dead space around a lone can.
